evidence.excerpt: To address this gap, we propose \textbf{EEGAgentBench}, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM agents on short- and long-horizon EEG analysis.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Although large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise as autonomous agents for EEG analysis, existing EEG agentic evaluations remain fragmented, covering limited tasks over narrow temporal horizons with inconsistent protocols, and providing no comprehensive assessment of agents' reasoning, tool-use, and workflow construction capabilities.
